primary_system: frozen SAL plus shared candidates plus single-edit gain CNN

candidate_pool.note: Engineering starting values, not empirically optimized. Freeze generation details, caps and deterministic tie rules before the next comparison; measure cap truncation and real-error oracle opportunity.

gain.short_cost: mean uncovered fraction of true events <=0.160 seconds; zero when none
gain.matching: maximum cardinality at tIoU>=0.5, then maximum total tIoU

model.architecture: small 1D CNN, pooled features, MLP, one Smooth-L1 regression output
model.feature_time_grid: document physical duration and resampling; preserve native annotations for evaluation

semantic_ablation.B3: B2 inputs plus word alignment and ASR quality
semantic_ablation.B4: B3 inputs plus POS and entity/category features
semantic_ablation.missing_or_unreliable_features: route explicitly to frozen B2 output and threshold

data.first_pilot: existing fixed10 train prediction cache for candidate and real-gain audit
data.expansion: more official train frozen-detector predictions if real-error support is insufficient
data.grouping: traceable source groups; recording-level fallback is weaker and must be disclosed
data.new_generalization_claim: requires an independent source untouched by this design cycle

success.primary: paired mean realized R reduction on the separate comparison set
constraints: false alarms on fully genuine recordings
success.pilot_screen: no observed constraint degradation; report uncertainty, not a noninferiority proof
success.reliable_improvement_claim: paired interval supports gain and declared constraint margins are satisfied
success.margins: must be fixed before the run; no empirically validated tolerance is asserted
success.not_a_new_metric: edited binary masks do not define continuous-score EER

reinspection_extension.interface: train an extended corrector with review-score channels and availability masks, then freeze it
reinspection_extension.review_target: actual frozen extended-corrector R without evidence minus R with evidence
reinspection_extension.no_new_evidence_benefit: do not train the review selector
reinspection_extension.budget: declare denominator; account for window union and context; separately report actual runtime
